project.name: NEAR Confidential Intents (FAR)
project.tagline: Confidential Intents on a permissioned private NEAR network with a mandatory public/private bridge
project.description: Assessment of the embedded Confidential Account path on near.com: private FAR network, intents.far, its mandatory bridge and relay/account infrastructure. Public NEAR is backing/settlement context where used; its ordinary validator count, history and unrelated NEAR AI/Chain Signatures guarantees are not credited to FAR.

summary: Independent manual assessment of NEAR Confidential Intents (FAR), not an official Privacy Benchmark evaluation. Public documentation describes hidden internal balances and fixed private transfers/swaps, with visible public funding boundaries. Access-controlled FAR infrastructure and a mandatory PoA bridge remain essential. Operator decryption access, TEE coverage, deployed FAR code correspondence and administrative thresholds are not established. Private-state recovery without the infrastructure is not supported by the documented path. Scores reflect conservative handling of researched unknowns; they are not proof that every uncertain risk exists.
